stayType: Hotel on North Walk, Lynton, on the South West Coast Path
accommodation: Family suites sleeping up to six, quad family rooms, king and twin rooms, many with sea views; also a self-catering penthouse apartment
parking: Car park with 12 spaces and two electric car chargers
confirmedFeatures: Dining room and breakfast room with sea views, evening meals and packed lunches offered, boot room, electric vehicle charging
overview: The North Cliff Hotel stands on North Walk in Lynton, right on the South West Coast Path. Many rooms have sea views and the hotel offers family suites and quad rooms, plus a self-catering penthouse. Breakfast and evening meals are served in sea-view dining rooms.
surfTripFit: A cliff-top walking and family base in Lynton rather than a surf stay; the surf beaches are further west on the North Devon coast.
